title: Sales forecasting app
subtitle: An operational app writes to its SQL database; mirroring lands every change in the shared lake for analytics.
note: SYNTHETIC illustration of a Fabric-style operational app (forecast vs actual). Generic names, no logos; not a vendor reference architecture, a tenant or a measured system.

layers.label: Shared lake
layers.description: One logical lake under every workload: mirrored and gold tables are kept once as open columnar files.

layers.label: Stores
layers.description: The app's transactional SQL database and the mirrored tables that land in the lake.

layers.label: Sync & transform
layers.description: Mirroring copies every committed change; a transform builds the forecast-vs-actual gold table.

layers.label: Model & service
layers.description: The data model generates the data API; the SQL analytics endpoint exposes lake tables read-only.

layers.label: App & report
layers.description: What people open: the editable forecast app and the forecast-vs-actual report.

layers.label: People
layers.description: Finance planners edit forecasts; executives read the result.

domains.label: Operational app
domains.description: Write path: UI, data API, data model and the SQL database.

domains.label: Analytics
domains.description: Read path: mirrored tables, gold transform, SQL analytics endpoint and report.

domains.label: Identity & access
domains.description: Cross-cutting sign-in, roles and row policies.

nodes.label: Shared lake
nodes.description: Single storage layer. Mirrored (bronze) and gold tables are open columnar files with snapshot history.

nodes.label: Forecast SQL DB
nodes.description: Transactional SQL database for departments, forecasts and actuals. Written only through the data API.

nodes.label: Mirrored tables
nodes.description: Read-only copies of the SQL tables, kept in the lake as bronze tables (one snapshot per batch).

nodes.label: Mirroring
nodes.description: Change feed from the SQL database to the lake: on every commit and on a short timer.

nodes.label: Gold transform
nodes.description: Builds the forecast-vs-actual gold table with variance from the mirrored tables.

nodes.label: Data model
nodes.description: Entities (Department, Forecast, Actual), relations and validation rules. The single source of truth for the API.

nodes.label: Data API
nodes.description: GraphQL/REST data API generated from the model. Validates every write and applies row policies.

nodes.label: SQL analytics endpoint
nodes.description: Read-only SQL endpoint over the lake tables, used by reports.

nodes.label: Workspace identity
nodes.description: Sign-in and roles (finance, executive). Every call carries a token checked by the API and the endpoint.

nodes.label: Forecast app
nodes.description: Editable forecast-vs-actual table with validation, KPI cards and a monthly chart.

nodes.label: Forecast vs actual
nodes.description: Report on the gold table: variance by department and month.

nodes.label: Variance alert
nodes.description: Planned: notify the planner when the variance of a department crosses a threshold.

nodes.label: Finance planner
nodes.description: Edits forecasts for their own department.

nodes.label: Executive
nodes.description: Reads the forecast-vs-actual report; cannot edit.

annotations.text: Near real time: one lake snapshot per batch of committed changes.
Row policies run on every call: planners edit only their department.
